Remember to memorize at least the main points from slides or else you will not be able to answer in exams.

HMB is the worst.
You will hear stories of Norway, which completely don't go with the course material or slides,
Out of 90 minutes, he will only teach 10min from the slides other than that, academic is 0.
If you want to save your CG please drop,avoid or whatever you can.
Mid and final questions, if you write just like the slides, you will get 20 out of 30 
. Idk what does he wants. And yes completely biased.
